summary: A US Amazon Associates member says Amazon texted them that global earnings are being folded into a single Storefront automatically, without the old OneLink setup steps (tax info is still needed per country). This is one Reddit report, not an official announcement yet.
YouTube Shopping's affiliate programme launched in France, letting creators tag products in videos, Shorts and live streams. YouTube says it has over 1.3 million creators signed up worldwide.
Button's CRO spoke at Adweek House about tighter budgets making shoppers more deliberate before the holidays, using Prime Big Deal Days as the example.
Bitly published a 2026 QR Code Trends Report. Nothing new from Lasso or URLgenius.

items.title: Amazon Creators Global Storefront earnings update
items.why: If Amazon is merging international earnings into one Storefront without OneLink, it's trying to make cross-country selling simpler from inside its own tools. It's a signal worth confirming, since international link routing is a core reason people use link tools.

items.title: Creator Connections campaigns keep getting fully claimed before I can accept them
Button CRO Lauren Newman at #ADWEEKHouse: "It's Not You, It's My Budget"
YouTube launches its YouTube Shopping affiliate programme in France
items.why: Another country where creators can earn from product tags inside YouTube itself. Platforms keep building their own shopping links, so creators end up with a separate setup for each one.
